faqACollect.description: Help and FAQ section on the options page
faqACollect.message: Your articles, tags and settings are written to this browser on this machine and are never uploaded. The extension makes a network call only when you check a license key, and when you send feedback you wrote yourself.

faqACustomShortcuts.description: Help and FAQ section on the options page
faqACustomShortcuts.message: Yes. Open chrome://extensions/shortcuts and set whichever combinations you prefer.

faqADelete.description: Help and FAQ section on the options page
faqADelete.message: Use Delete All Data in the Your Data section on this page. It clears the article database, the settings and the sync store, and it asks you to confirm first.

faqAExport.description: Help and FAQ section on the options page
faqAExport.message: Yes. Open Data on this page and choose Export Articles, or use Export All Data further down for settings and articles together. Both write a JSON file you can import again later.

faqAFavorites.description: Help and FAQ section on the options page
faqAFavorites.message: Click the star icon on the article card, or right-click it and choose Toggle Favorite. Favorites get their own tab in the side panel.

faqAFreeIncludes.description: Help and FAQ section on the options page
faqAFreeIncludes.message: Saving, reader view, the side panel, tags, title search, reading progress, offline copies, right-click save, Pocket import, export and reading stats. All of it, with no cap and no account.

faqALicenseKey.description: Help and FAQ section on the options page
faqALicenseKey.message: Open the license page from the upgrade screen, enter the key in the format XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX and choose Activate. The key is checked on the server, so you need to be online once.

faqANoContent.description: Help and FAQ section on the options page
faqANoContent.message: Some sites block content extraction. The URL and title are still saved so the original page stays one click away. A print or reader version of the same page often saves cleanly.

faqANotWorking.description: Help and FAQ section on the options page
faqANotWorking.message: Chrome blocks extensions on chrome:// pages, the Chrome Web Store and other extension pages. Try a normal website. If it still fails, switch the extension off and on again at chrome://extensions.

faqAOpenList.description: Help and FAQ section on the options page
faqAOpenList.message: Press Ctrl+Shift+L, which is Cmd+Shift+L on a Mac, to open the side panel. You can also right-click the extension icon and choose Open Reading List.

faqAOpenSettings.description: Help and FAQ section on the options page
faqAOpenSettings.message: Right-click the ReadLater Pro icon in your toolbar and choose Options. This page is where the reader theme, font size, content width and the rest live.

faqAPanel.description: Help and FAQ section on the options page
faqAPanel.message: Check that the extension is enabled at chrome://extensions, then click the toolbar icon and use the side panel button, or press Ctrl+Shift+L. Removing and reinstalling is the last resort, and it clears your local data, so export first.

faqAPocket.description: Help and FAQ section on the options page
faqAPocket.message: Open Data on this page and choose Import a file. Pocket's ZIP export, its CSV and the older HTML export all work. Articles, tags and read status carry over, plus highlights from the ZIP, and the import is free.

faqAPrice.description: Help and FAQ answer about cost. Carries no price number by design, see hard rule 2
faqAPrice.message: There are two ways in, a monthly plan you can cancel at any time and a one-time lifetime plan that never renews. The current figures are on zovo.one rather than in the extension, so what you read is always what you will be charged. Monthly cancels any time. Lifetime is final once your key arrives, and anything faulty gets fixed or refunded.

faqAReaderView.description: Help and FAQ section on the options page
faqAReaderView.message: Click any article in your reading list. It opens in a clean reader with the fonts, width and theme you set on this page.

faqAReset.description: Help and FAQ section on the options page
faqAReset.message: Scroll to the Danger Zone on this page and choose Clear All Data. That removes every article, tag and setting, and it cannot be undone. Export first if you want a copy.

faqASaveArticle.description: Help and FAQ section on the options page
faqASaveArticle.message: Click the ReadLater Pro icon in your toolbar, or press Ctrl+Shift+S, which is Cmd+Shift+S on a Mac. The page goes straight to your reading list.

faqASearchBase.description: Help and FAQ answer about search, first half
faqASearchBase.message: Yes. The search bar at the top of the side panel matches article titles, site names and short excerpts, with no limit. Full-text search reads inside the article body as well.

faqASearchCap.description: Help and FAQ answer about search, free daily allowance read from limits-config.json
faqASearchCap.message: On the free plan it covers $cap$ of those a day.

faqASearchCapUnknown.description: Help and FAQ fallback when the limits config cannot be read
faqASearchCapUnknown.message: On the free plan it has a daily allowance.

faqAShortcuts.description: Help and FAQ section on the options page
faqAShortcuts.message: Ctrl+Shift+S saves the page you are on. Ctrl+Shift+L opens the reading list. On a Mac both use Cmd instead of Ctrl.

faqASync.description: Help and FAQ section on the options page
faqASync.message: No. There is no sync and no account. Every device keeps its own list. Moving a list means exporting on one machine and importing on the other.

faqATags.description: Help and FAQ answer about tagging articles
faqATags.message: Right-click any article in your reading list and choose Add Tag. You can create a new tag or pick an existing one.

obFaqA1.description: ReadLater Pro first run, pricing step
obFaqA1.message: No. Saving, reader view, the side panel, tags, highlights, title search, offline reading, imports and the backup, CSV and bookmarks exports are free and uncapped. If you never upgrade, nothing you have saved gets taken away.

obFaqA2.message: One payment unlocks the Pro features in ReadLater Pro, including the ones added later. There is no renewal and nothing to cancel.

obFaqA3.message: Yes, and the import is free. Open Settings, choose the import option, and give it the export file Pocket produced. Titles, tags and read status come across.

obSignoffP1.message: I built ReadLater Pro after watching a service people relied on for a decade close its doors and take the reading lists with it. The fix is not a better cloud. The fix is keeping the list where you can see it, in your own browser, exportable any day you want it back.

obSignoffP2.message: It is one person here. I write the code, I read the support mail, and I answer it. If a page saves badly or the reader mangles something, send me the link and I will look at it myself.

obSignoffPs.message: One more thing. Lifetime is a single payment that never renews, and you saw both plans a moment ago. Saving and reading are free forever, and that part is the point.

obSignoffRole.message: a note from the person who wrote this

obStep1Kicker.message: For everyone who has lost a reading list once

obStep1Lede.message: Pocket shut down in July 2025, and a list people had trusted for years stopped being theirs. ReadLater Pro keeps your articles in your own browser, on your own machine, so no company can switch your reading list off.

obStep2Kicker.message: One click, and it is already saved

obStep2Lede.message: Pick something you already have open. ReadLater Pro puts it on your reading list in this browser right away, before you have agreed to anything and before we mention money. No account, no setup, and it is yours from that second on.

obStep3Lede.message: These are the real settings the reader uses. Nothing here is a preview, and you can change any of it later under Settings.

obStep4Lede.message: Your articles, tags and settings are written to this browser's own storage on this machine. Nothing is uploaded while you read, and there is no account to create.

obStep5Kicker.message: Saving and reading stay free, for good

obStep5Lede.message: Saving, reader view, the side panel, tags, highlights, title search, reading progress, right-click save, imports, offline reading and the backup, CSV and bookmarks exports are free, complete and uncapped. Unlimited full-text search, unlimited Listen and Markdown export sit behind the upgrade.

obStep6Lede.message: Three habits turn this into the place your reading actually lands. Pin the icon first, so saving is always one click away.
